description:
You have the 'inventory-manager' Maven project open in IntelliJ IDEA (located at ~/IdeaProjects/inventory-manager). The project contains 5 Java source files with messy, inconsistent formatting: mixed tabs and spaces, varying indentation sizes, wildcard imports (e.g., import java.util.*), unused imports, excessive blank lines, and trailing whitespace.

The project has a .editorconfig file that specifies the desired formatting rules (4-space indentation, no tabs).

Your task:
1. Select the src/main/java directory in the Project tool window
2. Apply 'Reformat Code' to the entire source directory (Code > Reformat Code or Ctrl+Alt+L) — make sure to apply it to the directory, not just one file
3. Apply 'Optimize Imports' to the entire source directory (Code > Optimize Imports or Ctrl+Alt+O) — make sure to apply it to the directory, not just one file
4. Save all files (Ctrl+S)
5. Build the project to verify it still compiles (Build > Build Project or Ctrl+F9)

After completion, all Java files under src/main/java/com/inventory/ should have consistent 4-space indentation (no tabs), no wildcard imports, no unused imports, no trailing whitespace, and the project must still compile successfully.
